claims: As of March 17, 2026, the average 30-year fixed mortgage rate is approximately 6.12% to 6.35%.
As of March 17, 2026, the average 15-year fixed mortgage rate is around 5.50% to 5.65%.
The previous week's Freddie Mac average of 6.11% for the 30-year fixed mortgage rate.
As of March 17, 2026, the current national average 5/1 ARM mortgage rate is approximately 6.34%.
As of March 17, 2026, the current national average VA 30-year mortgage rate is approximately 5.74%.
In the Freddie Mac survey in the week ending March 12, 2026, the 30-year fixed mortgage rate rose slightly from 6.00% to 6.11%.
Freddie Mac reports that purchase applications are increasing as buyers enter the spring market.
Freddie Mac reports that rates are still lower than the same period a year ago.
